contractsProvided.name: Thenable
contractsProvided.shape: type Thenable<Value> — re-exported from shared/ReactTypes; a thenable with a .status field

contractsProvided.name: Resource
contractsProvided.shape: type Resource<Input, Key, Value> = { clear(): void, invalidate(Key): void, read(Input): Value, preload(Input): void, write(Key, Value): void }

contractsProvided.name: createResource
contractsProvided.shape: function createResource<Input, Key, Value>(fetch: Input => Thenable<Value>, hashInput: Input => Key, config?: Config = {}): Resource<Input, Key, Value>

contractsConsumed.name: React.use
contractsConsumed.shape: React.use(Context: ReactContext<null>): any — invoked as readContext when available on React

contractsConsumed.name: ReactContext
contractsConsumed.shape: type ReactContext<T> — consumed as readContext parameter type

contractsConsumed.name: Thenable
contractsConsumed.shape: type Thenable<Value> — returned by fetch, consumed in accessResult and createResource signatures

contractsConsumed.name: FulfilledThenable
contractsConsumed.shape: type FulfilledThenable<Value> = Thenable<Value> & { status: 'fulfilled', value: Value }

contractsConsumed.name: RejectedThenable
contractsConsumed.shape: type RejectedThenable<Value> = Thenable<Value> & { status: 'rejected', reason: Error }

contractsConsumed.name: Promise.resolve
contractsConsumed.shape: Promise.resolve(value: Value): Promise<Value> — used in write() to create a pre-fulfilled thenable

moduleContractTests.scenario: createResource returns an object exposing the full Resource interface with five methods
moduleContractTests.then: result has clear, invalidate, read, preload, and write as functions

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource.read called outside of a React render context throws an error
moduleContractTests.then: throws Error: react-cache: read and preload may only be called from within a component's render. They are not supported in event handlers or lifecycle methods.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the invariant that read/preload must only be called during render

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource.read returns the resolved value when the fetch has fulfilled
resource.read rethrows the rejection error when the fetch has rejected
resource.read throws the pending thenable itself when the fetch has not yet resolved
moduleContractTests.then: throws the pending thenable object (status !== 'fulfilled' and !== 'rejected')
moduleContractTests.rationale: Supports React suspense by throwing the thenable for the renderer to suspend on

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource.invalidate removes a single cached entry while preserving others
moduleContractTests.then: entry for key1 removed; entry for key2 remains cached
moduleContractTests.rationale: Verifies per-key invalidation without clearing the entire resource

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource.clear removes all cached entries belonging to that resource
moduleContractTests.then: entries Map no longer contains this resource's entry sub-map

moduleContractTests.scenario: invalidateResources clears the global entries cache across all resources
moduleContractTests.then: entries Map is empty; all resources' cached entries gone
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures global cache reset works across independently created resources

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource.write directly stores a pre-fulfilled value in the cache
moduleContractTests.then: cached entry for key has status='fulfilled' and value=value

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource.preload caches the fetch result without throwing
moduleContractTests.then: fetch is called once and the result is cached; no error thrown

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource.read returns the cached thenable on consecutive calls without re-invoking fetch
moduleContractTests.then: fetch called only once; same cached result returned both times
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guarantees fetch is not called more than once per unique key

moduleContractTests.scenario: resource created with useWeakMap:true stores entries in a WeakMap
moduleContractTests.then: entries for this resource are stored in a WeakMap (non-object keys not supported)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Validates config.useWeakMap switches from Map to WeakMap for entry storage
